visible_chart.interpretation: The public published-indicator chart behaved as a fixed visible snapshot in these rounds. The naturally loaded quote payload changed, but no visible chart change was observed.

publishable_claims: Steady-state polling did not overlap while the second non-empty response was pending in three rounds.
The chart crop remained byte-identical across each 90-second hold and release sequence.
No stale, delayed, offline, disconnected, or reconnecting marker appeared.
ChartStore missing-required-field errors recurred in every round.
blocked_claims: The visible public chart rolled back to an older live quote.
The visible 61516.2 label is a stale current BTC quote.
The authenticated workspace uses the same quote transport or display policy.

cml.memory: The earlier older-after-newer delivery belongs to startup overlap evidence, not proven steady-state polling behavior.

ls.reason: The page displays a plausible chart while loading current quote payloads, but the visible surface does not explicitly establish whether the chart is live, delayed, or a historical snapshot.

next_experiments: Block naturally initiated ListQuotes responses in browser-local treatment rounds and compare visible chart behavior to test whether polling has a visible dependency.
Repeat the application-order probe specifically against the first-load duplicate quote pair, where overlap was previously observed.
Use an authorized workspace or an explicitly live public surface before making live-price freshness claims.
